Name: Dodo, Father of Eleazar
Summary: Father of Eleazar the Ahohite, one of the three mighties.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 11:12: Father of Eleazar the Ahohite, one of the three mighties.
LifeLesson: The mention of Dodo in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
